receipt: repair-10 defect N6 -- the tmpdir guard, observed live for the first time

defect_as_recorded.finding_text: STILL OPEN STRUCTURALLY. conftest.py has ZERO commits since repair-7's code_rev. Carries repair-8's caveat unchanged and honestly: the guard is inert wherever a writable tmpdir exists, which is the condition this round also had to create in order to execute the suite at all, so this round could not exercise it either.
defect_as_recorded.why_it_was_carryable_three_rounds: the stated impossibility is true of the process running the suite and false of a subprocess; it was recorded as a property of the world rather than of the framing

how_the_deadlock_was_broken.mechanism: a manufactured sitecustomize.py on PYTHONPATH breaks temp-directory creation at interpreter start -- before pytest, before conftest -- and a real pytest runs a throwaway suite that loads the REAL conftest by path
how_the_deadlock_was_broken.simulated_condition: mkdir under the temp root is refused; temp FILE creation works
how_the_deadlock_was_broken.why_not_the_textbook_condition: patching tempfile.gettempdir to raise prevents pytest from starting at all (_pytest.capture builds FDCapture from tempfile.TemporaryFile during pytest_load_initial_conftests), which bounds the guard's reach AND shows conftest.py's description of the historical sandbox ('provides no writable temporary directory') cannot be literally true, since pytest ran there and reported 23 ERRORS
how_the_deadlock_was_broken.why_TMPDIR_cannot_do_it: tempfile._candidate_tempdir_list falls through to /tmp, /var/tmp and cwd, so a bogus TMPDIR yields gettempdir()=='/tmp' and the probe reports writable -- measured in test_TMPDIR_alone_cannot_simulate_the_sandbox

coverage_measured_over_the_real_suite.method: the real conftest hook invoked over really-collected items with TMPDIR_WRITABLE forced False; strata assigned under a stated precedence so they are disjoint

before.note: measured on the CURRENT tree so both sides come from one collection; 6 of E and 1 of guard_skips are this change's own probe tests, so the pre-existing exposure was 113 and 156

deliberately_left_unskipped.why: whole-class source scanning was the obvious fix and would skip these; that is over-firing and hides real coverage, the failure mode symmetric to the one conftest.py was written for
deliberately_left_unskipped.Z_why_not_a_gap: test_fps_provenance.py::test_path_alias_ok is declared def test_path_alias_ok(tmp_path=None) and never uses it; measured -- it does not appear in that item's fixturenames, because pytest excludes parameters carrying defaults from fixture resolution

known_residual.shape: setUp builds an IMPORTED helper that owns the tmpdir
known_residual.remedy: the needs_tmpdir marker; Route4c/Route4d are the same shape without and with it

unittest_setUp_route.why: pytest's unittest integration runs setUp inside runtest, not in its own setup phase

error_vs_failure_derived_not_assumed.consequence: the ONLY stratum producing the ERRORS conftest.py justifies itself by is the fixture one -- which was the completely unguarded one. An earlier draft of this work asserted the setUp stratum was the erroring one; that was wrong and the phase assertion is what caught it.
error_vs_failure_derived_not_assumed.third_correction: TestReport.outcome is 'failed' for a setup break too; 'ERROR' is not a stored outcome, the terminal derives the label from when != 'call'. An assertion of outcome == 'error' could never pass.

mutation_test_of_the_fix.harness: each mutant applied to conftest.py, live test file re-run, file restored and sha256-verified

notes.M4_first_survived: deleting the direct setUp-source check changed nothing, because the probe used the INDIRECTION shape and the depth-1 walk covered it -- BEN-342 (a fixture degenerate on the axis under test) reproduced by the lane that filed it. Split into Route4a/Route4b.
notes.M4_exposed_a_real_over_reach: the depth-1 walk read the source of anything setUp mentioned, and setUp's first name is `tempfile`, whose module source contains every TMPDIR_APIS string -- so the walk was matching the stdlib, not the helper. Restricted to definitions owned by the test module.
notes.M6_removed: an explicit types.ModuleType check never fired (subsumed by isclass/isfunction) -- deleted as dead code rather than kept as an unfalsifiable guard
notes.M7_first_survived: the __module__ filter was unfalsifiable until Route4c asserted the thing it excludes STAYS excluded. Rule: a guard gets a test that it fires; a filter gets a test that it does not.

artifacts.why_they_cannot_be_caused_by_this_change: pytest_collection_modifyitems early-returns when TMPDIR_WRITABLE is True, which it is on this host (the report header says so), so the new detection code does not execute in an ordinary local run

scope.this_is_not_a_verdict: only the verifier lane can change a recorded defect count; repair-11 has not been issued. N6 is closed IN THE TREE.
